This falls at the very end of the very last chapter of Book 8: the well-documented fact that Hirtius's own continuation breaks off unfinished, mid-sentence ("Contendit..."). See about.json.

Book 8 was not written by Caesar (his own narrative ends after Book 7) but by his officer Aulus Hirtius, after Caesar's assassination. This is confirmed directly in the source text itself: Book 8's first chapter, uniquely numbered "0" in this edition, is Hirtius's own prefatory letter to Balbus explaining that he is continuing Caesar's unfinished Commentaries. See about.json for the full disclosure.
